jobs.title: AI in Residence
jobs.location: South San Francisco, California, United States
jobs.text:
About Xaira Therapeutics

Xaira is an innovative biotech startup focused on leveraging AI to transform drug discovery and development. The company is leading the development of generative AI models to design protein and antibody therapeutics, enabling the creation of medicines against historically hard-to-drug molecular targets. It is also developing foundation models for biology and disease to enable better target elucidation and patient stratification. Collectively, these technologies aim to continually enable the identification of novel therapies and to improve success in drug development. Xaira is headquartered in the San Francisco Bay Area, Seattle, and London.

AI in Residence

AI in Residence is a highly selective role at the intersection of frontier machine learning and drug discovery. Designed as an industry alternative to a traditional postdoctoral position, the program is for exceptional researchers and engineers who want to apply advanced AI to real biomedical problems end to end, from data to deployed systems.

Residents join a small cohort working on high-impact AI efforts across Xaira. You’ll collaborate closely with AI scientists, research engineers, and drug discovery teams to design, build, and ship machine learning capabilities that directly influence therapeutic programs. This is hands-on, system-level work with real scientific consequence.

We’re looking for candidates with technical depth, intellectual independence, strong research judgment, and evidence of delivering high-quality work—whether through publications, open-source, or production systems.

What You’ll Do

- Develop and advance ML models for biological, preclinical, and translational datasets (e.g., multimodal omics, imaging, text, assay data)

- Design and implement scalable pipelines for data curation, training, evaluation, and inference integrated into discovery workflows

- Own projects end-to-end: problem framing → prototyping → validation → deployment

- Evaluate robustness and reliability (generalization, uncertainty, failure modes), plus interpretability where it supports scientific decision-making

- Contribute technical leadership by proposing new directions, shaping platform capabilities, and raising engineering/research standards through collaboration

You Might Work On

Examples include (not limited to):

- Foundation / representation models over multimodal biological and translational data

- Methods for small, biased, noisy datasets; distribution shift; and uncertainty estimation

- ML systems for experimental prioritization, assay interpretation, or translational signal discovery

- Evaluation frameworks and benchmarks tailored to discovery decision-making

- Tooling that makes models usable by scientists (interfaces, automation, monitoring)

What Success Looks Like

- You ship one or more models or pipelines that are used in real discovery workflows

- Your work improves decision quality (e.g., better prioritization, faster iteration, clearer uncertainty)

- You raise the bar on evaluation rigor and reproducibility (strong baselines, error analysis, reliable metrics)

- You leave behind maintainable systems (tests, documentation, monitoring) that others can build on

We Value

- Strong research judgment: choosing the right problems and knowing what “good evidence” looks like

- Rigor: careful experimental design, ablations, error analysis, and honest reporting

- Systems thinking: reliability, scalability, and maintainability—not just prototypes
Clear communication: writing, documentation, and sharing decisions/assumptions

- Collaborative execution with scientific and engineering partners

Program Structure

Duration
6–12 months

Start Dates
Currently accepting applications for Fall 2026 and Winter/Spring 2027 starts.

Cohort Size
Small, highly selective cohort to enable meaningful ownership and close collaboration

Mentorship & Support
Dedicated technical mentor, plus structured feedback from senior AI, engineering, and scientific leadership

Publications & Presentations
We value scientific contribution and may support publications and conference presentations when appropriate. Publication scope and timing depend on project needs and are subject to internal review (e.g., IP and confidentiality). Authorship follows standard contribution-based guidelines.

The Company consents to Employee completing, publishing, and maintaining the manuscript and repositories listed on Exhibit A, including bona fide revisions during peer review, provided such work is performed on Employee's own time and equipment, uses no Company resources or Proprietary Information, and does not relate to the Company's business or actual or anticipated research and development. This consent extends only to rights held by Employee and does not address or affect any rights of third parties.

Who Should Apply

We encourage applications from candidates who meet most of the following:

- Recent MS or PhD graduates (or equivalent research experience) in ML/AI, computational biology, biomedical engineering, or related fields

- Evidence of research excellence through high-quality publications or artifacts. Top venues (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, CVPR, ACL; Nature Methods, Cell Systems) are a plus, but strong preprints, open-source contributions, or shipped systems with demonstrated impact are equally compelling

- Demonstrated ability to lead substantial technical work with originality—new modeling ideas, rigorous experiments, or production-grade systems adopted by others

- Motivation to translate rigorous research into reliable, deployable AI systems that support therapeutic discovery

Please include a brief cover letter describing your interest in this role, why you’re excited about this area, and what you hope to gain from the experience.

Compensation:

The expected monthly compensation range is $10,000–$15,000, depending on experience and qualifications. We are open to higher compensation for candidates with exceptional experience or impact.

As an Annotation Specialist, you will work on a team of dedicated individuals alongside our R&D Engineers and Researchers to advance the state-of-the-art in computer vision. Annotation is critical to the success of many of our computer vision projects; the annotations are used in scoring and evaluating our work as well as training our algorithms. Kitware’s Annotation team provides the key data annotation support within our computer vision team to meet these needs. The team uses a variety of software tools to label objects, activities, events, and other items of interest in images and video. 

This is an as-needed, project-dependent position with variable hours. Work availability will ebb and flow based on project needs, and a set number of hours each week is not guaranteed. The position requires flexibility to work on-site at Kitware’s headquarters in Clifton Park, NY when project needs require it, including work in a specialized facility. This position will also require obtaining the necessary government clearances. 


In This Position You Will:
- Use a variety of desktop and web-based software tools to review picture and video sources to identify objects, activities, events, and other items of interest to Computer Vision Researchers in images and video. 

- Perform diverse, detailed annotations in the form of bounding boxes, polygon segmentation, and metadata markups in accordance with established group procedures and a high degree of accuracy.

- Work with custom in-house software to troubleshoot bugs and optimize the annotation process.

- Learn new tools and/or technologies as necessary to follow team workflow and accomplish annotation tasks.

- Use an agile workflow for tracking responsibilities and task progress, including git for task/issue tracking.

- Work in a fast-paced environment that evolves regularly in response to changing research and customer needs.

Required Qualifications:
- Excellent attention to detail.

- Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

- Willing to learn new tools or programs as project needs evolve and workflows change.

- Comfortable being proactive and asking questions or for clarification when needed. 

- Proficient in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) or Google Suite.

- Excellent customer service focus and communication skills, both oral and written; ability to effectively communicate with multiple individuals in varying levels of the organization.

- Ability to maintain confidential data.

- Good interpersonal skills and a team player.

- High school degree required, advanced degree preferred.

- Flexibility to work variable, project-dependent hours. Work may be available regularly during active project periods, while other periods may have limited or no hours. A minimum or set number of weekly hours is not guaranteed.

- Ability and willingness to work on-site at Kitware’s headquarters in Clifton Park, NY when required by project needs.

- If not already cleared TS/SCI, willingness and ability to apply for and maintain a TS/SCI security clearance.

- Due to contractual requirements, this position requires U.S. citizenship.

Company Description:
Kitware is a research and development software solutions provider with a mission to advance science, make a positive impact, and share our results all within a collaborative, employee-focused work environment that is friendly, fair, and flexible. Our work is improving healthcare outcomes, increasing national security, and advancing our national computing infrastructure. Our customers and collaborators include top universities from around the world, government organizations, national research labs, medical device manufacturers, car manufacturers, financial institutions, and many others.  
 
Kitware is proud to be 100% employee-owned.

jobs.title: Associate Software Engineer
jobs.text:
About The Position
Our mission is to connect constituencies to their elected representatives at all levels of government, and as a member of our engineering team, you will play a crucial role in delivering first-rate customer service to our many clients. You’ll have the potential to be working anywhere in the stack, from creating delightful front-end user experiences and improving upon existing and building new backend functionality and internal APIs. This position supports delivery of projects end-to-end under the guidance and support of experienced team members. 
Your specific mission is to help our front-line support team solve technical client issues, providing timely solutions and escalating problems to the full development team. You should feel comfortable handling tickets, learning about new software, and communicating with both our support and development teams. You will also be instrumental in helping set up and maintain our production servers.
 
About The Team
Fireside provides software-based communications solutions to Members of Congress and state and local representatives and entities that allow their teams to work smarter, reach further, and discover more. Every day, we help our clients foster stronger connections. https://www.fireside21.com/
Our team has a wealth of diverse life and career experiences that allow us to think outside of the box and ahead of the curve. You will get the opportunity to drive the future through new products that delight, while working with a mix of product, design, application engineers, data engineers, and AI experts to devise, nurture, and implement cutting-edge solutions to continuously evolving engineering obstacles.
 
About You
Motivated. Collaborative. Eager to learn. Excellent communicator. You’re ready to build your skills in web technologies and contribute to meaningful projects. You’re excited to work in a team environment, sharing ideas and solutions with colleagues, and you thrive on the challenge of meeting evolving client needs to achieve bold results. You relish the challenge of helping our clients accomplish their design goals while pushing them to consider and advocating for modern web design, user-experience, and accessibility standards and initiatives.
 
Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States on a full-time basis. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.


What To Expect In This Position
- Deliver excellent service to internal and external stakeholders who include officials of both parties in their official capacity.

- Escalate bugs to the engineering team and track progress within Jira.

- Fix technical problems that front-line support cannot like troubleshooting printer issues, investigating email problems, and performing back-end data updates for clients, among others.

- Monitor production systems for problems.

- Learn how to debug websites and email newsletters using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript.

- Discover the fundamentals of SQL queries and level up your SQL skills.

- Assist with contributions to data pipelines. Our data pipelines span data ingestion, engineering, and search processes to deliver key insights to users. You’ll learn the ins and outs of data validation and optimization to help ensure data accuracy.

- Gain hands-on experience with various backend and web application technologies.

- Partner with teams across R&D functions (Engineering, Product, QA, Data, etc.) to build cohesive, cross-functional solutions.

- Help provide a polished user experience by contributing to responsive and engaging application features for internal and external clients.

What Sets You Apart
- Early coding skills with a desire to learn and grow through software problem-solving.

- 0-1 years of hands-on experience in scripting, software development or equivalent knowledge with modern tech stacks.

- Ability to interpret client specifications, identify website user requirements, and make solid recommendations during client and team meetings.

- Ability to communicate technical information to non-technical audiences.

- Familiarity with .NET and C#, or other object oriented languages.

- Experience with Angular, python, MSSQL, and Redis

- Familiarity with cloud environments and development in Linux/Unix systems (experience with AWS, Bash, nginx, etc. is a plus).

- Familiarity with building and testing HTML email newsletters that function and look great across various email clients.

- Interest in Generative AI and LLM technologies, with a curiosity to learn more.

- Eagerness to learn, explore, and embrace new technologies and development practices.

- SQL knowledge is a plus.

Match Group is a leading provider of dating products across the globe. Our portfolio includes Tinder, Hinge, Match, Meetic, PlentyOfFish, OkCupid, The League, HER, and others, each designed to spark meaningful connections for singles worldwide. Creating a sense of belonging doesn’t stop at our products - it’s the foundation of every team we hire.
 
When it comes to dating, the connection starts online, but the real magic happens once you meet in real life (IRL).  We think the same is true for creating the best platforms, so we work together IRL 3 days/week.


We are seeking a talented and motivated early-career software engineer to join the Match Group Core in a brand new role enabling greater productivity in non-technical teams through bespoke software and workflow solutions.
Match Group Core is the central services division for Match Group, providing shared services and data solutions for all brands under the Match Group portfolio, including Tinder, Hinge, Match.com, POF, OKC, and many others. Additionally, Match Group Core is a technical service provider for many internal central and corporate teams, such as HR, Finance, Accounting, Legal, Privacy, Marketing, IT, and Security.
With a special focus on internal product development and workflow enablement, you'll play a crucial role in designing, building, and maintaining internal products and workflow solutions (HR/People-focused) that benefit employees across the organisation. Most crucially, you will be enabled with extensive agentic tooling to achieve your goals, and in turn, you will be expected to impart your expertise on your stakeholders, and enable them with AI to achieve their own goals.
This role is a paid, fixed-term 4-6 month internship, with an opportunity that this role can be converted into a full-time permanent position at the conclusion. This is also a hybrid role, and requires in-office collaboration three times per week.


In this role, you will: 
In this role, you will:

- 
Partner directly with corporate teams (primarily HR) to understand their problems and ship working internal tools quickly: dashboards, portals, small web apps, reports, and integrations.

- 
Use AI-assisted development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc) as your primary means of building, while applying engineering judgement to what those tools produce.

- 
Administer, optimize, and expand a multi-tenanted Databricks platform to meet evolving analytics and business intelligence requirements.

- 
Teach and coach non-technical stakeholders to build and maintain their own AI-assisted workflows and tools, which may include running informal group sessions and pairing sessions, or producing guidance, templates, or sufficient guardrails that they can leverage or re-use.

- 
Develop and deliver solutions according to lightweight but sensible software development methodologies, with close collaboration MG Core's product engineering arm, to ensure what is built is secure and maintainable.

- 
Create and maintain clear documentation, including technical notes, integration docs, and operational and how-to guides written for a non-technical audience.

- 
Monitor and troubleshoot the tools you ship, providing timely fixes and keeping stakeholders informed.

- 
Keep up to date with the fast-moving AI tooling landscape and bring the best of it back to the team.

- 
Gain broad exposure across Match Group’s central services and corporate functions.

What We're Looking For:
- 
0-2 years of professional experience as a software engineer, or a recent degree, diploma, or bootcamp qualification in a relevant field.

- 
Hands-on experience using agentic development harnesses and similar AI tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, etc), with experience or familiarity with agentic instructions (AGENTS.md, skills) and MCP servers.

- 
A strong understanding of foundational software principles and programming fundamentals, as well as development lifecycles, spanning source control (GitHub), CI/CD (automated testing and quality analysis), and monitoring (logs, metrics, error detection and troubleshooting).

- 
Familiarity with software delivery methodologies, such as agile scrum or kanban.

- 
Experience in building modern web frontends (using React or similar), as well as accompanying backend REST APIs.

- 
Familiarity with relational/SQL, as well as NoSQL or KV databases.

- 
Working knowledge of cloud platforms (such as AWS, GCP, Azure, Cloudflare), including conceptual understanding of serverless concepts.

- 
Strong interpersonal and communication skills - a significant part of this role is explaining technical work to non-technical people, so patience, empathy, and clarity matter as much as coding ability.

- 
Solid understanding of IT security concepts, as well as sound judgement around data sensitivity and confidentiality - much of what you build will touch employee and business data.

- 
Excellent problem-solving skills and a bias toward delivering value quickly rather than getting it perfect - as is the nature of internal tooling.

- 
Strong enthusiasm for software development and eagerness to learn and grow.

- 
Legally authorized to work in Canada for the duration of the internship.

Nice to have:
- 
Any exposure to HRIS platforms, especially Workday - even light experience as a user or administrator of a HRIS or similar is valuable here.

- 
Experience in the Human Resources domain, or with people data, recruiting, payroll, or benefits systems.

- 
Experience working within specific cloud environments, namely Cloudflare (primary) and AWS (secondary).

- 
Experience working with serverless hosting technologies, such as Cloudflare Workers.

- 
Experience working within containerised environments, such as Docker and/or DevContainers.

- 
Exposure or experience working within project management tools such as Jira or Monday.com.

- 
Experience contributing to open source projects.

- 
Experience working at a B2B or SaaS company.

Why Match Group?
 
Our mission is simple – to help people find love and happiness! We love our employees too and understand the importance of all life's milestones.

We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, creed, national origin, ancestry, disability, marital status, age, sexual orientation, sex (including pregnancy and sexual harassment), gender identity or expression, uniformed service or veteran status, genetic information, or any other legally protected characteristic.  Period.

jobs.title: Watchfloor Analyst - I, II, and III
jobs.text:
About Agile Defense
 
At Agile Defense we know that action defines the outcome and new challenges require new solutions. That’s why we always look to the future and embrace change with an unmovable spirit and the courage to build for what comes next.
 
Our vision is to bring adaptive innovation to support our nation's most important missions through the seamless integration of advanced technologies, elite minds, and unparalleled agility—leveraging a foundation of speed, flexibility, and ingenuity to strengthen and protect our nation’s vital interests.


Requisition #: 1848, 1849, and 1850
Job Title: Watchfloor Analyst - I, II, and III
Location: On-Site, McLean, VA
Clearance Level: Top Secret / SCI,  Must Have Clearance to Start


Job Description
Conducts independent intelligence analysis, integrating data from multiple sources to identify threats, vulnerabilities, and pattern trends to enhance threat awareness. Develops reports and briefings for decision-makers and stakeholders. Works closely with cybersecurity, defense, and/or security teams to provide analytic support to further operations. Utilizes advanced analytical tools to improve intelligence assessments.

Responsibilities/Duties: 

- Analyzes, assimilates, and evaluates all available intelligence information relating to their assigned area of responsibility;

- Responsible for selecting new and pertinent material for the files and for recognizing important new information which may suggest the necessity for further examination or study;

- Prepares finished studies of factual data;

- Provides specialized intelligence and threat analysis and production support;

- Accesses and performs research on designated automated intelligence databases for the purpose of identifying information of interest to the customer, downloading the identified information to an appropriate medium, and editing the information into format(s) to be specified by the customer;

- Provides intelligence and threat analysis of the information that is tailored to the customer's requirements;

- Develops information and technical support documents, summaries, reports, presentations and other designated products in support of the customer's information and technical support requirements; and

- Presents briefings to personnel designated by the customer.

Experience, Education and Background
- Level I - Entry Level with Bachelors Degree in a industry relevant field

- Lever II - 2 years of experience + Bachelors degree

- Level III - 4 years of experience + Bachelors Degree

- Four (4) additional years of experience may be substituted for degree.

Required Skills
- Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work within a team environment.

- Demonstrated proficiency in all Microsoft Office applications to include Access and Outlook.

- Possess skill in following procedures and paying attention to detail. 

- Demonstrated oral communication and interpersonal skills to work within a team environment.

- Demonstrated written communication skills sufficient to explain actions taken and how recommendations were derived.

Preferred Skills
- Experience with administrative and technical writing, and editting/proofreading (highly desrirable)

- Experience utilizing Power BI

Working Conditions
Full Time onsite. Working from a desk within SCIF 12 hour shifts (6am-6pm or 6pm-6am). Shifts operate on a 2-3-2 schedule on 2-week intervals (Mon-Tue Scheduled Onsite, Wed-Fri Off, Sat-Sun Scheduled Onsite, Mon-Tue Off, Wed-Fri Schedule Onsite; Sat-Sun Off)

Our Core Values
 
Employees of Agile Defense are our number one priority, and the importance we place on our culture here is fundamental. Our culture is alive and evolving, but it always stays true to its roots. Here, you are valued as a family member, and we believe that we can accomplish great things together. Agile Defense has been highly successful in the past few years due to our employees and the culture we create together. 
 
What makes us Agile? We call it the 6Hs, the values that define our culture and guide everything we do. Together, these values infuse vibrancy, integrity, and a tireless work ethic into advancing the most important national security and critical civilian missions. It's how we show up every day. It's who we are.
 
Happy - Be Infectious. Happiness multiplies and creates a positive and connected environment where motivation and satisfaction have an outsized effect on everything we do.
Helpful - Be Supportive. Being helpful is the foundation of teamwork, resulting in a supportive atmosphere where collaboration flourishes, and collective success is celebrated.
Honest - Be Trustworthy.Honesty serves as our compass, ensuring transparent communication and ethical conduct, essential to who we are and the complex domains we support.
Humble - Be Grounded.Success is not achieved alone, humility ensures a culture of mutual respect, encouraging open communication, and a willingness to learn from one another and take on any task.
Hungry - Be Eager.Our hunger for excellence drives an insatiable appetite for innovation and continuous improvement, propelling us forward in the face of new and unprecedented challenges.
Hustle - Be Driven.Hustle is reflected in our relentless work ethic, where we are each committed to going above and beyond to advance the mission and achieve success.

jobs.title: OSTP Software Developer
jobs.text:
Earn your master's degree while building real-world open source software.
Kitware's Open Source Software Technology Program (OSTP) is a full-time position for talented and curious new Computer Science and Computer Engineering graduates, offering an opportunity to launch their careers while earning a master's degree in Computer Science.
You'll work on real-world open source software projects, develop your technical and leadership skills, and complete your graduate education - all while earning a competitive salary.
You'll gain experience developing innovative software with applications across areas such as computer vision, scientific computing, data and analytics, medical computing, and software solutions. Along the way, you'll learn not only how to build and maintain powerful open source platforms, but also how successful technical projects are led, funded, and sustained.
How it Works
OSTP Software Developers join Kitware as full-time, permanent employees from day one. The program is designed to combine professional software development experience with graduate study, with the master's degree typically completed over a three-year period.
Throughout that time, you'll work on-site at Kitware's Clifton Park, NY headquarters while completing your master's coursework. Your work schedule is designed with the demands of graduate study in mind, with flexibility during the academic year to balance your Kitware responsibilities and coursework. During the summer and other academic breaks, you'll have greater availability to focus on your work at Kitware.
Kitware covers 100% of educational expenses for your master's degree. By the time you complete your degree, you'll have also gained approximately three years of professional experience developing open source software. And because OSTP is a permanent position - not a three-year appointment - we hope earning your master's degree will be one milestone in a long-term career with Kitware.


What You'll Do
- 
Work on a variety of real-world open source software projects.

- 
Develop software with applications across computer vision, scientific computing, data and analytics, medical computing, and other technical areas.

- 
Build a deep understanding of what it takes to create, maintain, and grow powerful open source software platforms.

- 
Learn open source software development processes and best practices.

- 
Develop technical and business knowledge that can prepare you for future leadership opportunities.

- 
Learn the fundamentals of project leadership.

- 
Gain exposure to how funding is acquired to support the development and growth of open source platforms.

- 
Complete your master's degree in Computer Science while gaining professional software development experience.

What We're Looking For
This position is specifically designed for recent graduates who are ready to continue their education while beginning their professional software development careers. 

- 
Be completing a bachelor's degree in Computer Science or Computer Engineering in Spring 2027. December 2026 graduates will also be considered.

- 
Have demonstrable programming experience through undergraduate projects, internships, or similar experience.

- 
Have experience programming in both C++ and Python.

- 
Have strong communication skills.

- 
Be willing and able to meet the program's on-site work requirements in Clifton Park, NY.

- 
Due to contractual requirements, this position requires U.S. citizenship and a willingness and ability to obtain and maintain a security clearance.

Employment visa sponsorship is not offered for this position.

Preferred Qualifications
- Existing experience with open source software development.

Why Kitware?
Kitware is a research and development software company working to advance science, make a positive impact, and share our results. Our work contributes to areas including healthcare, national security, scientific discovery, and advanced computing, and our customers and collaborators include government organizations, national laboratories, leading universities, medical device manufacturers, technology companies, and other organizations around the world.
Open source software is central to how we work. For someone beginning a career in software development, that means an opportunity to learn by contributing to real software, working alongside experienced researchers and developers, and seeing how collaborative software projects grow from technical ideas into platforms used by others.
We're also 100% employee-owned through an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). Eligible employees have the opportunity to share in the value they help create, giving our people a meaningful stake in Kitware's long-term success.
Our employees enjoy a collaborative work environment, flexibility in their assignments, significant independence, and the opportunity to take ownership of their work.
Benefits include:
Six weeks of paid time off
Flexible working hours
Competitive compensation
401(k)
Health and life insurance
Short- and long-term disability insurance
Free coffee, drinks, and snacks
For more information on our benefit offerings please visit: https://www.kitware.com/careers/.
Living & Working in New York's Capital Region
The OSTP is offered exclusively at Kitware's Clifton Park, NY headquarters, putting you in the heart of New York's Capital Region.
This area offers the conveniences and culture of city living with a distinctly small-town feel. From Broadway shows and outdoor concerts to a strong local dining scene, there’s plenty to do without the pace of a larger metropolitan area.
What really sets the region apart is its access to the outdoors. With an abundance of parks, lakes, nature preserves, and trails, outdoor recreation is part of life year-round from hiking and boating in the warmer months to skiing and snowshoeing in the winter.
Kitware's Clifton Park headquarters includes collaborative gathering spaces, an oversized kitchen stocked with beverages and snacks, and an expansive outdoor patio.
Equal Employment Opportunity
Kitware actively subscribes to a policy of equal employment opportunity. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, age, protected veteran status, uniformed service member status, or any other characteristics protected by applicable law.
If you need assistance with applying or interviewing for a role due to a disability or special need, please reach out directly to our HR team at hr@kitware.com at any time during the hiring process.
Any unsolicited resume sent to Kitware, including to Kitware's mailing addresses, fax machines or email addresses, whether directly to Kitware employees or to Kitware's applicant tracking system, will be considered Kitware property.  Kitware will not pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited resume, and will consider any candidate submitted by a recruitment agency without a fully executed contract with Kitware to have been referred free of any charges or fees.

jobs.title: Client Report Services - Performance Analyst
jobs.text:
About the Position
Callan is seeking a new team member to join our Client Report Services (CRS) team located in the Portland, OR office. As a Performance Analyst in the Client Report Services (CRS) group at Callan, a leading independent investment consulting firm, you’ll be responsible for calculating and verifying portfolio returns and characteristics. From this analysis, you’ll produce investment measurement reports that provide important insights into the performance of our client portfolios. Our goal is to identify a candidate with a genuine interest in investments, data analysis, and reporting, has intellectual curiosity, strong project and time management skills and a true appreciation for the value of building strong, trusted relationships with clients and fellow Callan colleagues.  
 
Please note: This position will be expected to work a hybrid schedule, with approximately two (2) days a week in the office.
 
What’s Unique about This Role?
Callan believes our organization and culture are made stronger through a broad array of perspectives and experiences. Collaborating with various teams throughout the company, you will work with some of the highest- quality and most complex clients in the country to help them achieve their investment goals. Along with having an appreciation for Callan’s unique and collaborative culture, your ability to demonstrate success in the skill sets we seek is of greater importance than your years of experience.
 
In this position, you’ll have an opportunity to support some of the largest, most sophisticated institutional investors in the U.S., including pension and defined contribution plans, endowments, foundations, insurance companies, and health care organizations. Along the way, you’ll hone the fundamentals of investment measurement reporting, learn the specific needs of large institutional investors, and critical skills to take your career to the next level.
 
Primary Duties:
 
Data Collection and Evaluation:
·          Calculate returns using custodial statements
·          Reconcile returns with investment managers
·          Obtain client information from investment managers/recordkeepers 
·          Generate portfolio characteristics 
·          Verify dividends/capital changes
 
Production of Investment Measurement Reports:
·          Interact with clients and consultants on report content 
·          Check returns and analysis for content and reasonability
·          Respond to special requests
·          Obtain non-custodial information for mutual/commingled/real estate/private equity funds
·          Generate custom reports using various proprietary software programs 
 
Job Skills and Requirements
 
Skills:
·        Be proficient in Microsoft Excel, Word, and Outlook 
·        Excellent interpersonal, communication, and organization skills
 
Characteristics:
·        Have a familiarity/interest in the institutional investment market
·        Be self-motivated, accurate, detail-oriented, and able to work independently while meeting numerous deadlines
·        Be able to thrive in an unstructured environment
·        Resourceful and have a great deal of patience
·        Strong desire to learn and drive to excel 
 
Education and Experience:
·        Bachelor’s degree required, preferably in finance, statistics, mathematics, or related degree
·        0-2 years of professional work experience, preferably in finance or the investment industry.  New college graduates are encouraged to apply.
 
Compensation, Benefits & Training
 
At Callan, you can expect:
·          A generous compensation and benefits package, including base salary, bonus, 401(k) matching, profit-sharing, health/medical/dental/vision benefits, monthly communications stipend, tuition assistance, and more
·          Training for all Callan databases, research, and other systems
·          Access to team-building events, community outreach opportunities, and wellness events


About Callan
Callan was founded as an employee-owned investment consulting firm in 1973. Ever since, we have empowered institutional clients with creative, customized investment solutions that are backed by proprietary research, exclusive data, and ongoing education. Today, Callan provides advisory services to institutional investor clients with more than $3 trillion in total assets, which makes it among the largest independently owned investment consulting firms in the U.S. Callan uses a client-focused consulting model to serve pension and defined contribution plan sponsors, endowments, foundations, independent investment advisers, investment managers, and other asset owners. 
 
Callan has roughly 200 employees and is headquartered in San Francisco with five additional offices throughout the U.S. Learn more about us at www.callan.com.
 
Callan is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa at this time.
 
Research shows that some candidates tend to apply only if they meet 100% of the criteria. We are committed to leveling the playing field, and we encourage everyone to apply for positions even if they do not necessarily check every box outlined in the job description. Callan believes that our organization and culture are made stronger through a broad array of perspectives and experiences.

- 
Brings their own unique background to the team, adding fresh ideas and perspectives

- 
Is self-driven in solving problems and capitalizing on learning opportunities

- 
Is comfortable navigating ambiguity, and knows when to ask for help versus dig in independently

- 
Is a strong communicator with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

- 
Has an awareness of how to present information in the era of AI tooling

1-4 years as a professional software developer

- 
Experience utilizing AI tools to drive both technical and non-technical workflows

- 
A solid foundation in professional software development practices and system design

- 
A strong communicator who can build consensus around technical approaches, address ambiguity with stakeholders, and effectively present information

- 
A high bar for code quality, automated testing, and engineering best practices

- 
Aligned with Rover Core Values

- 
Plus: Experience with any of the technologies we support - Python/Django, Elasticsearch, React/React Native

- 
Plus: Experience working in a relevant domain - search or two-sided marketplaces

Our Style:
- 
We are proud to be professional software developers building high quality, scalable and supportable solutions.

- 
We are curious and passionate about learning, providing the right environment and resources for professional growth.

- 
We are committed to building, fostering and maintaining a culture of inclusivity and diversity both on our teams and in our products.

- 
We embrace progressive engineering practices and the evolving software development industry, including AI Native development, automated testing and a continuous deployment pipeline.

- 
We are serious about the quality of our production operation, and have thorough system, application and user interaction monitoring and anomaly detection.

- 
We are passionate about data-driven decision-making.

-

And, dogs in the office. Bring yours, too!

Benefits of Working at Rover.com:

Competitive compensation

- 
401k

- 
Flexible PTO

- 
Competitive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance

- 
Commuter benefits

- 
Bring your dog to work (and unlimited puppy time)

Doggy benefits, including $1000 toward adopting your first dog

- 
Stocked fridges, coffee, soda, and lots of treats (for humans and dogs) and free catered lunches semi-monthly

jobs.title: Contract Student Worker - Data Analyst (20 hrs/wk)
jobs.text:
About Zoox

Zoox is an autonomous ridehailing company building the world's first purpose-built robotaxi — fully electric, bidirectional, with no steering wheel or driver's seat. Backed by Amazon and founded to make transportation safer, cleaner, and more accessible, Zoox designs its vehicles entirely around the rider. We're currently operating in Las Vegas and San Francisco, with Austin and Miami on the horizon, and testing underway across seven U.S. markets.

About Our Part-Time Student Worker Program

Zoox's part-time student worker program puts you at the center of one of the most ambitious challenges in transportation. You'll contribute to real projects, work alongside engineers and researchers pushing the boundaries of autonomous technology, and gain experience that goes well beyond the classroom. We're looking for students who bring strong academic foundations, curiosity that doesn't stop at coursework, and a drive to be part of something that matters.

Role Overview
We are seeking a Data Analyst to support the data systems and reporting that power our autonomous fleet operations. You'll transform vehicle telemetry, service logs, and operations data into clear insights that improve decision-making across operations, safety, and engineering teams. This role focuses on analytics, reporting, KPI development, and building accessible datasets and dashboards that help teams understand performance and drive improvements.

Responsibilities
- Analyze vehicle telemetry, service logs, dispatch data, and operational metrics to identify trends and actionable insights

- Build and maintain dashboards and recurring reports for fleet operations, safety, and engineering stakeholders

- Define, track, and report on KPIs related to fleet performance, mission success, readiness, and operational efficiency

- Ensure datasets used for analysis are accurate, well-structured, and reliable

Required Qualifications
- Pursuing Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Analytics, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or a related field

- Experience with operational, logistics, or fleet-related data is a plus

- Strong proficiency in SQL for querying, data manipulation, and analysis

- Proficiency in Python for data analysis and reporting preferred

- Experience with data visualization tools (Looker, Tableau, or Power BI)

- Experience working with large datasets and transforming raw data into actionable insights

- Familiarity with Databricks or similar analytics platforms is a plus

Program Requirements
- Construct live operational dashboards to visualize fleet health, downtime metrics, and operator efficiency metrics.

- Currently enrolled in a B.S. or M.S. program in a relevant discipline.

- Optimize database queries across NoSQL and SQL structures to ensure rapid retrieval of historical fleet data for weekly operational reviews.

- Available to commit to a minimum three-month assignment.

- Aggregate and analyze large sets of vehicle performance data to provide actionable recommendations for improving fleet utilization and reducing idle times.

- Able to commit a minimum of 20 hours per week.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration

- Able to work on-site at one of our office locations.

- Interface directly with L3 hardware and software engineering teams to ensure operational tools accurately reflect the latest autonomous system capabilities and constraints.

- Must adhere with Zoox confidentiality requirements, including refraining from using or sharing proprietary company information outside of Zoox, such as in academic research, theses, publications, or presentations.

- Gather feedback from on-the-ground fleet operators to continuously iterate and improve the UX/UI of internal tools.

About Zoox
Zoox is developing the first ground-up, fully autonomous vehicle fleet and the supporting ecosystem required to bring this technology to market. Sitting at the intersection of robotics, machine learning, and design, Zoox aims to provide the next generation of mobility-as-a-service in urban environments. We’re looking for top talent that shares our passion and wants to be part of a fast-moving and highly execution-oriented team.

Follow us on LinkedIn

Accommodations
If you need an accommodation to participate in the application or interview process please reach out to accommodations@zoox.com or your assigned recruiter.

A Final Note:
You do not need to match every listed expectation to apply for this position. Here at Zoox, we know that diverse perspectives foster the innovation we need to be successful, and we are committed to building a team that encompasses a variety of backgrounds, experiences, and skills.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.text:
As a rapidly growing organization, Vitana Pediatric & Orthodontic Partners is looking for a Data Analyst to join our team. This is a great opportunity for an early-career data professional who wants hands-on experience building the data infrastructure and reporting capabilities that support a growing, multi-location healthcare organization.

The Data Analyst will work closely with leadership to help organize, validate, and transform data from multiple practice management systems into reliable, actionable information. This individual will play an important role in developing Vitana's centralized data warehouse and ensuring our teams have accurate data to make better business decisions.

Key Responsibilities

- Assist in designing and maintaining normalized data schemas for key business and operational metrics, including production, collections, appointments, treatment starts, and other practice-level KPIs.

- Build and maintain data extraction processes to pull information from multiple Practice Management Systems across Vitana's locations.

- Develop validation processes to ensure data is complete, accurate, and consistent across systems.

- Reconcile data within the centralized data warehouse against existing practice and corporate reporting.

- Write and maintain SQL queries and Python scripts used for data extraction, transformation, validation, and analysis.

- Support the development and maintenance of Vitana's centralized data warehouse.

- Build and maintain dashboards and reporting using BI tools such as Power BI, Looker Studio, or Tableau.

- Partner with Finance, Operations, Marketing, and other departments to understand reporting needs and translate business questions into meaningful analysis.

- Identify inconsistencies, trends, and opportunities within large datasets and communicate findings clearly to business stakeholders.

- Assist with documentation of data sources, definitions, processes, and reporting logic.

- Support ongoing improvements to Vitana's data infrastructure as the organization continues to grow and add practices.

Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Data Science, Business Analytics, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.

- 0–3 years of relevant professional experience; strong recent graduates with applicable internships, projects, or technical experience are encouraged to apply.

- Experience working with or building data warehouses such as Google BigQuery, Microsoft Azure, Amazon Redshift, or similar platforms.

- Working knowledge of SQL and/or Python.

- Experience with business intelligence and visualization tools such as Power BI, Google Looker Studio, Tableau, or similar platforms.

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with excellent attention to detail.

- Ability to validate and reconcile data across multiple sources.

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, growing environment where priorities may evolve.

- Strong communication skills and the ability to work collaboratively with both technical and non-technical team members.

- Healthcare, dental, or multi-location business experience is a plus, but not required.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who is naturally curious, analytical, and excited about solving problems with data. The ideal candidate doesn't just pull numbers, they want to understand where the data comes from, whether it is accurate, and how it can be used to help the business operate more effectively.

This is an opportunity to join Vitana at an exciting stage of growth and have a meaningful role in building the data foundation that will support the organization as we continue to scale.

jobs.text:

This role is well suited for someone who is curious, adaptable, technically comfortable, and able to translate between business needs and emerging AI capabilities. The individual will support WisdomTree’s growing AI program and work closely with the firm’s AI Tech & Operations leadership and the AI Enablement Analyst to help execute AI initiatives across training, workflow design, solution development, and user adoption. 

While the position has a primary emphasis on enablement, training, adoption, and business engagement, the individual will be cross-trained across solution-building activities and expected to contribute broadly across the team’s AI initiatives.

This role is open to candidates located in the greater New York metropolitan area or within a commutable distance.

jobs.title: 2027 Graduate Analyst
jobs.text:
Our Story
 
Hello there. We’re Zopa.
 
We started our journey back in 2005, building the first ever peer-to-peer lending company. Fast forward to 2020 and we launched Zopa Bank. A bank that listens to what our customers don’t like about finance and does the opposite. We’re redefining what it feels like to work in finance. Our vision for a new era of banking puts people front and centre — we’ve built a business that empowers everyone to aim high, every day, to move finance forward. Find out more about our fantastic offerings at Zopa.com! 
 
We’re incredibly proud of our achievements and none of it would be possible without the amazing team here. It’s not just industry awards we’re winning, we’ve also been named in the top three UK’s Most Loved Workplaces. 
 
If you embrace unconventional challenges, are unafraid to think differently and are driven to make an outsized impact, you’ll thrive here at Zopa, so join us, and make it count. Want to see us in action? Follow us on Instagram @zopalife


What does an Analyst at Zopa do?
At Zopa, our Analysts don’t just analyse the business – they help shape it.

From designing our products and customer experiences, to deciding our lending criteria and target markets, our Analysts are at the heart of every major decision we make.

You’ll combine creative problem solving with strong numerical and communication skills, turning data into insights and ideas into real-world impact. You’ll have meaningful ownership from the start, while learning from talented colleagues across the business.

It’s no surprise we’re one of the UK’s 100 Most Loved Workplaces. But don’t just take our word for it – hear from some of our recent grads:

“You’re surrounded by smart, driven, and insightful people, with whom you are always facing an engaging challenge – there are no boring days here.”

“Zopa has broken every negative stereotype I had of working at a bank. As a company it is always pushing new boundaries, and as an individual you are constantly encouraged to innovate.”

“I love how you start with a group of graduates from diverse backgrounds at the same time, and Zopa strikes a great balance between challenging you and setting you up for success.”

How will we help you get started?
You don’t need to arrive knowing every tool or technique! Your first four months will include a structured graduate training programme designed to give you a broad foundation across Analytics at Zopa. You’ll rotate through four placements and complete a project for each, giving you the chance to apply your learnings to real business problems. We make extensive use of AI-tools (both generic foundation models and skills developed locally) in all our work including knowledge discovery, code development, and task automation. Training in relevant AI tool use is also part of each of the placements:

- Intro to Zopa & Technical Skills – get to know Zopa, our products and how we use data, while deepening your technical skills (including SQL and Python)

- AI Applications – Learn how analysis using large language models and associated transformer-based architectures is applied to real business problems

- Data Science – Develop your data science skills, including building gradient boosted and sequence-based models, and put them into practice in a competition to build the best model to address a real prediction problem

- Product Economics – understand the economics behind our product design and lending decisions, and learn techniques for forecasting future value

Together, these placements provide broad training in the tools, concepts and business context used across our Analytics teams, preparing you to join any of the analyst teams within Zopa.

What teams do Graduate Analysts join at Zopa?
After completing our training programme, you'll join one of our teams. As you grow, you'll have opportunities to explore new projects and internal moves. You can expect to:

- Take real ownership from day one – using data to investigate problems, test ideas and recommend improvements to our products, customer experience and business performance.

- Build your technical skills using cutting edge tools and techniques

- Turn data into insights and communicate these to stakeholders across functions and levels

You'll learn more about each area of Analytics at Zopa throughout our hiring process and training programme. To give you a flavour of the different opportunities…

Credit Strategy 🎯

Shape the lending decisions that drive Zopa’s growth and profitability. You will develop, model and test lending strategies, explore how changes affect customers and commercial performance, and help turn analysis into real lending decisions.

Product Analytics 📊

Build insight and recommendations that drive product decisions, prioritisation and strategy. You will run in-depth analysis, design tests, monitor performance, and build self-serve tools to enable others in their work (for example, conversational analytics). 

Data Science 🧪

Design and deploy cutting-edge predictive models that power Zopa’s products and decisions. You will be pushing boundaries in both the data sources and techniques that you apply to some of our most challenging problems, taking ideas from the experimentation stage through to production deployment.

Technology ⚙️ 

The roles of Zopians in our Technology teams are varied and rapidly evolving as the power of the tools we use to support building, testing, and deploying software grow more powerful. We have exciting opportunities across a broad set of disciplines including software engineering, data engineering, analytic engineering, information security, and technology delivery. 

Risk Lab 🤖

The management of risk is an area where we see huge potential benefit from the application of large language models and associated deep learning techniques. You will apply your analytic skills to a wide range of challenges from across the business such as customer experience, financial crime, diagnosing technology incidents, and much more.

Could you be our next Graduate Analyst?
We’re not expecting you to know everything already. We’re looking for people who are:

- Numerically confident – comfortable working with mathematics at A-level complexity

- Analytical – able to break down complex challenges, apply logic and make thoughtful judgements

- Naturally curious – keen to ask questions, explore data and understand how things could work better

- Excited by technology – interested in learning tools such as Python and SQL and exploring how AI is changing the way we work

- Ready to Dream Big – curious and ambitious, willing to challenge existing thinking and make progress even when the answer isn’t obvious

- Prepared to Own It – willing to take initiative, take responsibility for outcomes and follow things through

- Motivated to Win Together – collaborative, open to different perspectives and focused on achieving great outcomes with others

What’s the application and interview process like?
- Applications opened on Tuesday, 1st September and will close at 9am UK time Sunday, 25th October.

- Once you apply, you will receive a link to complete our online assessments with Aon, our testing provider. These will take up to ~45 minutes total and you will have 1 week after applying to complete the assessments.

- If you are successful at the assessment stage, you will be invited to complete a recorded video interview via Aon. This video interview process may take up to 45 minutes to complete, and you will have 1 week to complete this after receiving the invitation.

- We will also be inviting applicants who have passed the assessment stage to a virtual webinar on either Friday, 16th October or Friday, 6th November. These are a great chance for you to learn more about life at Zopa, hear from our leaders, and get our top tips for success!

- If you are successful at the recorded video interview stage, we will invite you to one of our in-person case study interview days hosted at our beautiful Canary Wharf office! These are our only available interview dates, so please mark them in your diary:

- Monday, 2nd November

- Wednesday, 4th November

- Wednesday, 11th November

- Friday, 13th November

- Wednesday, 25th November

- Friday, 27th November 

- If you are successful at this stage, you will be invited to a second-stage remote case study interview, which will be conducted in late November or December.

- Our remote final-stage interviews will take place throughout December and January, depending on which in-person case study day you participated in, with all offers out by late January.

What can Zopa offer you?
- £45,000 starting salary + £5,000 signing bonus

- Up to 10% annual discretionary bonus

- Hybrid working

- A structured graduate training programme and ongoing development opportunities

- Industry-leading benefits

- A spacious, open-plan office with private terraces in Canary Wharf

- Real ownership from day one

These roles may be best suited to 2026 and 2027 graduates who are ready to start in February or September 2027. If you’ve already graduated and have a few years of experience, look out for our additional experienced roles on our careers page!

#LI-OH1


At Zopa we value flexible ways of working.
We value face-to-face collaboration and a good work-life balance. This hybrid role requires you to come to our London office 2-3 days a week.
You'll also have the option of working from abroad for up to 120 days a year!* But no matter where you are, we’ll make sure you’ve got everything you need to thrive, both in your work and home life, from day one.
*Subject to having the right to work in the country of choice
 
Diversity Statement
Zopa is proud to offer a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and backgrounds leads to better products for our customers and a unique company culture for our people. We are made up of nearly 50 nationalities, have a DE&I forum made up of Zopians wanting to make a difference and we are proud of our culture where everyone can bring their full self to work. Our approach to DE&I is reflected in our hiring process so please let us know if you require any reasonable adjustments. 
 
Our approach to AI in interviews
At Zopa, AI isn't something we're testing out — it's part of how we work every day. As a proud partner of Jobs 2030, we're committed to building AI fluency across our workforce, and we expect Zopians to use AI as part of how they do their jobs. 
Because of that, we want to be transparent about how we think about AI use during our hiring process. 
Behavioural and competency-based interviews: please don't use AI. These conversations are designed to understand you — your experiences, your judgment, and how you've approached real situations. An AI-generated answer can't tell us that. What it can do is get in the way of us finding out whether we're the right fit for each other. 
Technical interviews: it depends on the role. Some technical stages actively welcome AI use, others don't. Your Talent Partner will let you know what's expected at each stage. Where AI is part of the assessment, we'll be interested not just in the outcome, but in how you used it – the tools you chose, your reasoning, and the decisions you made along the way.

jobs.text:

jobs.text:
hatch I.T. is partnering with Expression to find a Junior Data Engineer (DEA). See details below:
About The Role:
Expression is seeking a Junior Data Engineer to support the Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) Investigative Case and Data Ecosystem (ICDE) modernization effort. The program is focused on replacing fragmented legacy investigative and case management capabilities with a centralized, secure, scalable, and integrated ecosystem.
Working alongside experienced data engineers and other technical team members, the Data Engineer 2 will support data ingestion, transformation, validation, migration, and integration activities. This is an early-career opportunity for an individual with foundational data engineering knowledge who is interested in developing hands-on experience supporting a large-scale Federal technology modernization program.
Clearance: Secret level required and willingness to pursuit TS/SCI.
Location: Arlington, VA. The program is primarily onsite at DEA Headquarters.
About the Company:
Founded in 1997 and headquartered in Washington DC, Expression provides data fusion, data analytics, software engineering, information technology, and electromagnetic spectrum management solutions to the U.S. Department of Defense, Department of State, and national security community. Expression’s “Perpetual Innovation” culture focuses on creating immediate and sustainable value for their clients via agile delivery of tailored solutions built through constant engagement with their clients. Expression was ranked #1 on the Washington Technology 2018's Fast 50 list of fastest growing small business Government contractors and a Top 20 Big Data Solutions Provider by CIO Review.


Responsibilities:
- Assist in designing, developing, and maintaining ETL pipelines for ingesting, transforming, and loading datasets under the guidance of more experienced engineers.

- Support migration of legacy data into the modernized DEA investigative and case management ecosystem.

- Assist with analyzing data structures, source-to-target mappings, and data-quality checks to identify issues or gaps.

- Help ensure data accuracy, consistency, and integrity by executing validation queries, profiling datasets, and supporting data-cleaning efforts.

- Contribute to data migration activities, including mapping source data to target systems and executing migration scripts.

- Support data cleaning, standardization, classification, and tagging activities.

- Collaborate with analysts, data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders to translate requirements into data transformations and pipeline updates.

- Monitor pipeline performance and assist with troubleshooting operational issues, escalating complex issues as appropriate.

- Participate in validation activities and help document migration results and identified data-quality issues.

- Participate in Agile ceremonies and support data engineering activities throughout development sprints.

- Help document data flows, transformation logic, mappings, and operational processes to support maintainability and knowledge sharing.

Qualifications: 
- Bachelor's degree in STEM fields and 0–1 years of professional experience.

- Foundational exposure to data analysis, ETL concepts, or data migration through coursework, internships, personal projects, or early professional experience.

- Working knowledge of SQL, including basic queries, joins, and aggregations.

- Familiarity with Python for data manipulation or automation tasks; introductory-level experience is acceptable.

- Introductory experience with ETL or workflow tools such as Apache Airflow, Talend, or similar technologies.

- Understanding of basic data warehousing concepts, including staging, fact/dimension models, or schema structures.

- Exposure to cloud-based data storage or compute platforms such as AWS S3/Redshift, Google BigQuery, Azure Storage, or similar environments.

- Foundational understanding of data profiling, validation, and data quality.

- Strong communication and documentation skills.

- Ability and willingness to learn in a fast-paced, evolving technical environment.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Hands-on or coursework experience with AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform.

- Exposure to Hadoop, Spark, or other distributed-processing technologies.

- Familiarity with Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or similar visualization tools.

- Familiarity with Git or similar version-control systems.

- Experience building or supporting automated data workflows using orchestration tools or scheduled scripting.

- Exposure to Agile development methodologies.

- Coursework, internship, project, or professional exposure to data migration or system-modernization activities.

Benefits:
Expression offers competitive salaries and benefits, such as:
401k matching
PPO and HDHP medical/dental/vision insurance
Education reimbursement
Complimentary life insurance
Generous PTO and holiday leave
Onsite office gym access
Commuter Benefits Plan

What does it mean to be a Data Developer at GLS?
As a Data Developer, you will be responsible for building fast, reliable, transparent, and scalable business-focused information systems. You will design and build standardized ETL processes used to populate the data warehouse and feed data to stakeholders and business partners. You will also design and develop dashboards and reports that are distributed throughout the organization and to external partners.


How will you drive value within the organization as a Data Developer?
- Design, build, enhance, and maintain fault-tolerant batch-based and real-time ETL processes to make new and existing data sources readily available to analysts, applications, and external business partners

- Design and build data warehouses/data lakes/data marts to provide easy access to structured and semi-structured data for analysts and data scientists

- Design, build, enhance, and maintain Power BI and SSRS reports and dashboards working from specification documents and/or direct interaction with business users

- Automate manual data processes and optimize user queries

- Decipher existing reports and database processes to assist users, analysts, and data stewards in understanding reports

- Set up internal and external secure data exchanges using industry-standard encryption techniques

- Implement data security measures to protect PII and other sensitive information

- Integrate processes and tools to monitor and improve data quality and system stability as prescribed by the data governance team

- Complete work with an emphasis on efficiency, quality, and maintainability

What should you already know to be successful as a Data Developer?
- Minimum of bachelor’s degree required

- Professional or educational experience in ETL, Business Intelligence, or Statistical Analytics required

- Strong understanding of SQL including basic joins, inserts, updates, deletes, conditional logic, subqueries, temp tables, and data transformation functions

- Proficient knowledge of relational database management systems required

- Experience reviewing datasets for data quality required

- Experience with un- or semi-structured data (ex. XML, JSON) preferred

- Experience with any data integration tool preferred

- Experience with reporting platform like Power BI and SSRS preferred

- Experience with different data security algorithms preferred

- Intrinsically motivated with demonstrated ability to take initiative, identify needs, make recommendations for improvement, see recommendations through implementation, and evaluate improvements for effectiveness 

- Strong verbal and written communication skills

- Team player that can adapt in a fast pace and changing environment 

- Commitment to exemplifying the organizational core values and key competencies

Employment Requirements:
- This is an exempt level position whereby business need will dictate the exact work schedule which should be expected to vary at times. Generally, days and hours of work are flexible between the hours of Monday through Friday, 8:00am-6:00pm with a minimum expectation of 40 hours per week

- Significant portions of daily assignments involve application of manual skills requiring motor coordination in combination with finger dexterity.

- Remain in a stationary position up to 100% of the workday.

- Constantly operate a computer and other standard office equipment 

- Job functions involve sedentary to light physical effort. Physical demands range from sitting, walking, standing, or pushing or pulling materials. Work may involve exerting up to 10 pounds of force to lift, carry, push, pull, or move objects.

- Be able to perform activities such as: viewing a computer terminal, extensive reading, bending, and kneeling.

- The position does not require travel, though travelling opportunities may arise
